disabledService: This service is disabled; its quotas cannot be edited.
unknownService: This service's quota observation is unavailable. Unknown is not zero; editing is blocked.
invalidLimit: Enter whole numbers of zero or greater, or -1 for unlimited. Leave a field blank to omit it.
noChanges: Change at least one project limit before saving.
policyHelp: Use -1 for unlimited. A blank field removes that policy entry: ceilings become unconstrained; defaults defer to the native service. RAM is MiB, storage is GiB; other units are shown in resource labels.
projectHelp: Only changed fields are sent. A blank field leaves the native limit unchanged. -1 means unlimited, not unknown. In-use and reserved observations are separate and are never added to allocation limits.
allocationHelp: The budget constrains the sum of project quota allocations made through Afterglow. It is not live consumption or a universal native domain cap. Disabled projects are included. Missing ceilings are unconstrained; missing defaults use native policy.
drift: Observed allocations exceed a domain ceiling. External native changes can cause drift; lowering or repairing allocations remains subject to server validation.
durableBlocker: A durable quota operation is still applying or has an unknown outcome. Further quota and policy writes are blocked. Reload observations; a system administrator must confirm native calls have settled before reconciliation. Never replay the original mutation.
defaultsHelp: Defaults apply only to future projects created through Afterglow. They never rewrite existing project limits.
loadFailed: Could not load the current observations.
scopeMismatch: The returned scope does not match this workspace. Reload after re-authenticating.
defaultsSaved: Defaults were saved. Reload to observe the current policy.
projectSaved: The requested project limits passed native readback. Reload current observations before another edit.
budgetSaved: The allocation budget was saved. Reload the current policy before another edit.
partialOutcome: The operation was only partially applied. Inspect its durable service results after reloading; do not replay the request.
unknownOutcome: The operation's final outcome is not established here. A failure does not prove nothing changed. Reload the policy and durable operations; do not replay the request.
reloadRequired: Editing is paused until you reload observations. Reload performs reads only and discards the submitted draft; it never retries a mutation.
adminHelp: System administration edits domain allocation ceilings only. Project allocations and future-project defaults belong in the domain manager workspace. Existing domain monitoring remains read-only.
reconcileHelp: First independently confirm the original native calls are no longer running. This action reads current limits and resolves the operation fence; it does not retry native writes or guarantee the original requested result.
settledConfirm: I have confirmed that every original native call has settled.
reconciledOutcome: Reconciliation recorded current native limits, not the original request. Reload to inspect the resulting budget and operation state.
noObservations: No observed rows. Missing coverage is not proof that no resources exist.
attributionHelp: Resources are observed across exact-domain projects, including disabled projects and joined users. Project limits are allocations, not consumption. Partial values are lower bounds; unavailable and unsupported observations are never zero.
userQuotaHelp: User rows show only resources with an explicit native user owner. Project membership does not imply resource ownership. Native project quotas are never queried or presented as per-user quotas.
chooseScope: Choose a project or user to view attributed resources.
inventoryHelp: Display metadata only. Unknown user ownership stays unattributed and is not assigned to every project member. Unsupported services are explicit in the observation table.
